raw.description: 自身使用攻击技能时触发时空加速|自身受到攻击后若攻击伤害高于对方阵亡精灵体力上限之和的60%则触发时空乱流|战斗阶段结束时触发时空折跃|回合结束时若对手体力大于0且本回合未受到时空加速的伤害则触发时空交错|（boss无效）
raw.analyze_desc: [sprite name=dot4]自身使用攻击技能时触发[color=#f35555]时空加速[/color]|[sprite name=dot4]自身受到攻击后若攻击伤害高于对方阵亡精灵体力上限之和的60%则触发[color=#f35555]时空乱流[/color]|[sprite name=dot4][color=#57c975]战斗阶段结束时[/color]触发[color=#f35555]时空折跃[/color]|[sprite name=dot4][color=#57c975]回合结束时[/color]若对手体力大于0且本回合未受到[color=#f35555]时空加速[/color]的伤害则触发[color=#f35555]时空交错[/color]

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 最新确认交错回复按理论1000、阈值按完整结算伤害，补全免疫、减免、过量以及200至400中档下回合实际红减60%；真实其他阵亡队列与主动换宠流程独立延期。

success.name: 4865真实2050时空加速实际用攻即触发，面板速度60%附粉不计能力等级，MISS/整招无效仍执行，控制属性药剂不执行
success.assertion: test('4865真实2050时空加速实际用攻即触发，面板速度60%附粉不计能力等级，MISS/整招无效仍执行，控制属性药剂不执行',()=>{for(const level of[-6,0,6]){const s=make({move:10361,soul:true,aStats:{spe:500}});s.fighters[0].stages.spe=level;turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.spacetime2050.windows.length,1);}for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control','status','potion']){const s=make({move:10361,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(s,mode==='status'?29251:mode==='potion'?null:10361);const n=mode==='miss'||mode==='invalid'?300:0;assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.spacetime2050?.windows.length??0,n?1:0);}});

success.name: 4865真实2050加速下两回合全技能先制独立累计与到期，百分比免疫零伤不算受到加速伤害而触交错按理论回复
success.assertion: test('4865真实2050加速下两回合全技能先制独立累计与到期，百分比免疫零伤不算受到加速伤害而触交错按理论回复',()=>{const s=make({move:10361,soul:true});for(const n of[0,1,2]){turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n);}turn(s,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.spacetime2050.windows.length,3);s.moveDefinitions[key(29251)].operations=[];turn(s,29251);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);turn(s,29251);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,0);const immune=make({move:10361,soul:true});timer(immune,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(immune);assert.equal(immune.fighters[0].soulState.spacetime2050.intersections[0].settledDamage,0);assert.equal(sum(immune,'fixed'),0);assert.equal(sum(immune,'percent'),0);assert.ok(sum(immune)>0);assert.equal(immune.fighters[1].hp,9000-sum(immune));});

success.name: 4865真实2050时空折跃按实际已损60%魂印回血与净回复等量粉，200边界神游清异常，技能禁疗不阻魂印且回复倍率归零触发未回复分支
success.assertion: test('4865真实2050时空折跃按实际已损60%魂印回血与净回复等量粉，200边界神游清异常，技能禁疗不阻魂印且回复倍率归零触发未回复分支',()=>{for(const [hp,restored]of[[1000,4800],[8500,300],[8665,201],[8666,200],[9000,0]]){const s=make({move:10361,index:-1,soul:true,hp});s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');let before,after;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='combatEnd'&&c.a.side===0){after=c.a.hp;assert.equal(c.a.hp,hp+restored);assert.equal(!!c.t.ailments['神游'],restored<=200);assert.equal(!!c.a.ailments['烧伤'],restored>200);}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(after,hp+restored);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),300+restored);}const no=make({move:10361,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(no,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:1});turn(no);assert.equal(no.fighters[0].hp,1000);assert.equal(sum(no,'percent'),300);assert.ok(no.fighters[1].ailments['神游']);});

success.name: 4865真实2050时空交错无减免无过量两段各1000固定伤害与对等回复，净HP状态真实；减免和HP不足按理论回复与完整结算伤害分支提交
success.assertion: test('4865真实2050时空交错无减免无过量两段各1000固定伤害与对等回复，净HP状态真实；减免和HP不足按理论回复与完整结算伤害分支提交',()=>{const s=make({move:29251,index:-1,soul:true});turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),1000);const self=(s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.round===1&&e.sourceSide===0&&e.targetSide===0&&e.type==='fixed');assert.equal(self[0].settledDamage,1000);assert.equal(self[0].hpLoss,1000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000);for(const mode of['immune','reduced','overkill','self-immune']){const a=make({move:29251,index:-1,soul:true,targetHp:mode==='overkill'?200:9000});if(mode==='immune')timer(a,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='reduced')timer(a,1,'固定百分比减伤',{fraction:.5});if(mode==='self-immune')timer(a,0,'固定百分比免疫');turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].hp,mode==='overkill'?0:9000);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,['immune','self-immune'].includes(mode)?9000:8000);}});

success.name: 4865真实2050乱流当前对手已阵亡仍执行消逝，活对手不消逝；只把真实其他阵亡队列留第二阶段
success.assertion: test('4865真实2050乱流当前对手已阵亡仍执行消逝，活对手不消逝；只把真实其他阵亡队列留第二阶段',()=>{const s=make({move:10361,index:-1,soul:true,bStats:{maxHp:1000,atk:9999}});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='receivedAttack'&&c.a.side===0&&c.t.hp>0)c.hurt(c.t,5000,'当前受击时反击的已结算输入','fixed');},()=>turn(s,10361,10127));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.vanished,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stats.maxHp,0);assert.ok(s.vanishEvents.some(e=>e.side===1));const alive=make({move:10361,index:-1,soul:true});turn(alive,10361,10127);assert.equal(alive.fighters[1].soulState.vanished,undefined);});

success.name: 4865已答时空交错：减免后完整固伤决定400与200阈值，每次均以理论1000回复；过量与免疫不改理论基数
4865已答交错中档：200至400授下回合实际红减60%，当回合不提前生效，隔回合到期；非红不减
success.assertion: const s=make({soul:true,move:29251,index:-1});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeIncomingDamage'&&c.a.side===1)c.amount=300;},()=>turn(s));const base=structuredClone(s);delete base.fighters[0].effects['额外攻击减伤'];const attack=s.fighters[0].moves.find(k=>['physical','special'].includes(s.moveDefinitions[k].kind));for(const x of[s,base])x.moveDefinitions[attack].operations=[];for(let r=2;r<=3;r++){for(const x of[s,base]){x.fighters[1].ailments={};x.rng=0x9e3779b9;turn(x,+attack.split(':')[1],10127);}const actual=sum(s,'attack',1),control=sum(base,'attack',1);assert.ok(control>0);assert.ok(Math.abs(actual-control*(r===2?.4:1))<=1);}

boundary.assertion: const s=make({soul:true,move:29251,index:-1});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeIncomingDamage'&&c.a.side===1)c.amount=300;},()=>turn(s));const base=structuredClone(s);delete base.fighters[0].effects['额外攻击减伤'];const attack=s.fighters[0].moves.find(k=>['physical','special'].includes(s.moveDefinitions[k].kind));for(const x of[s,base])x.moveDefinitions[attack].operations=[];for(let r=2;r<=3;r++){for(const x of[s,base]){x.fighters[1].ailments={};x.rng=0x9e3779b9;turn(x,+attack.split(':')[1],10127);}const actual=sum(s,'attack',1),control=sum(base,'attack',1);assert.ok(control>0);assert.ok(Math.abs(actual-control*(r===2?.4:1))<=1);}

interaction.name: 4865真实2050时空加速实际用攻即触发，面板速度60%附粉不计能力等级，MISS/整招无效仍执行，控制属性药剂不执行
interaction.assertion: test('4865真实2050时空加速实际用攻即触发，面板速度60%附粉不计能力等级，MISS/整招无效仍执行，控制属性药剂不执行',()=>{for(const level of[-6,0,6]){const s=make({move:10361,soul:true,aStats:{spe:500}});s.fighters[0].stages.spe=level;turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.spacetime2050.windows.length,1);}for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control','status','potion']){const s=make({move:10361,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(s,mode==='status'?29251:mode==='potion'?null:10361);const n=mode==='miss'||mode==='invalid'?300:0;assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.spacetime2050?.windows.length??0,n?1:0);}});

success.assertion: test('4865/4与5全部重复能力实例按参数执行，47四回合免弱，191反弹优先次数免异，478属性整招无效，843下两回合先制2',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let index=0;index<m.effectInstances.length;index++){const e=m.effectInstances[index];if(![4,5].includes(e.id))continue;const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=(e.args[1]===100?1:24);seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,index,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);const side=e.id===4?0:1,baseline=side===1&&e.args[0]===0?1:0;seen.add(s.fighters[side].stages[keys[e.args[0]]]-baseline);}assert.ok(seen.has(e.args[2]));if(e.args[1]<100)assert.ok(seen.has(0));}const weak=make(row(47));turn(weak);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.stage(c.t,-2,['def']);assert.equal(c.t.stages.def,0);}},()=>turn(weak));const reflect=make(row(191));turn(reflect);reflect.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,2);}},()=>turn(reflect));const block=make(row(478));turn(block);assert.equal(block.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);assert.equal(block.fighters[1].effects.statusBlock.end,2);const priority=make(row(843));turn(priority);priority.moveDefinitions[key(25528)].operations=[];for(const n of[2,2,0]){turn(priority);assert.equal(priority.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n);}});

success.name: 4865/4与5全部重复能力实例按参数执行，47四回合免弱，191反弹优先次数免异，478属性整招无效，843下两回合先制2
success.assertion: test('4865/4与5全部重复能力实例按参数执行，47四回合免弱，191反弹优先次数免异，478属性整招无效，843下两回合先制2',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let index=0;index<m.effectInstances.length;index++){const e=m.effectInstances[index];if(![4,5].includes(e.id))continue;const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=(e.args[1]===100?1:24);seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,index,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);const side=e.id===4?0:1,baseline=side===1&&e.args[0]===0?1:0;seen.add(s.fighters[side].stages[keys[e.args[0]]]-baseline);}assert.ok(seen.has(e.args[2]));if(e.args[1]<100)assert.ok(seen.has(0));}const weak=make(row(47));turn(weak);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.stage(c.t,-2,['def']);assert.equal(c.t.stages.def,0);}},()=>turn(weak));const reflect=make(row(191));turn(reflect);reflect.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,2);}},()=>turn(reflect));const block=make(row(478));turn(block);assert.equal(block.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);assert.equal(block.fighters[1].effects.statusBlock.end,2);const priority=make(row(843));turn(priority);priority.moveDefinitions[key(25528)].operations=[];for(const n of[2,2,0]){turn(priority);assert.equal(priority.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n);}});

success.assertion: test('4865/4与5全部重复能力实例按参数执行，47四回合免弱，191反弹优先次数免异，478属性整招无效，843下两回合先制2',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let index=0;index<m.effectInstances.length;index++){const e=m.effectInstances[index];if(![4,5].includes(e.id))continue;const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=(e.args[1]===100?1:24);seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,index,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);const side=e.id===4?0:1,baseline=side===1&&e.args[0]===0?1:0;seen.add(s.fighters[side].stages[keys[e.args[0]]]-baseline);}assert.ok(seen.has(e.args[2]));if(e.args[1]<100)assert.ok(seen.has(0));}const weak=make(row(47));turn(weak);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.stage(c.t,-2,['def']);assert.equal(c.t.stages.def,0);}},()=>turn(weak));const reflect=make(row(191));turn(reflect);reflect.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,2);}},()=>turn(reflect));const block=make(row(478));turn(block);assert.equal(block.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);assert.equal(block.fighters[1].effects.statusBlock.end,2);const priority=make(row(843));turn(priority);priority.moveDefinitions[key(25528)].operations=[];for(const n of[2,2,0]){turn(priority);assert.equal(priority.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n);}});

success.name: 4865/198两能力无放回随机各弱2，521反转自身弱化遵守保护，768按异常种数固定附伤，836与954按真实HP关系先制
success.assertion: test('4865/198两能力无放回随机各弱2，521反转自身弱化遵守保护，768按异常种数固定附伤，836与954按真实HP关系先制',()=>{const s=make(row(198));turn(s);assert.equal(keys.filter(k=>s.fighters[1].stages[k]<0).length,2);for(const v of Object.values(s.fighters[1].stages))assert.ok([-2,-1,0,1].includes(v));for(const protectedCase of[false,true]){const a=make(row(521));a.fighters[0].stages.def=-2;if(protectedCase)timer(a,0,'弱化不可解除反转');turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.def,protectedCase?-2:2);}for(const n of[0,1,2]){const a=make(row(768));if(n)a.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']=3;if(n===2)a.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;turn(a);assert.equal(sum(a,'fixed'),300*n);}for(const [id,hp,want]of[[836,8999,0],[836,9000,0],[954,8999,1],[954,9000,0]]){const a=make({...row(id),hp});turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,want);}const high=make({...row(836),targetHp:8999});turn(high);assert.equal(high.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);});

success.name: 4865/693下两回合红增100%与986先手红增50%只红伤，768固定附伤不因红增变化
success.assertion: test('4865/693下两回合红增100%与986先手红增50%只红伤，768固定附伤不因红增变化',()=>{const a=make(row(693)),base=make({move:29251,index:-1});for(const s of[a,base]){s.moveDefinitions[key(38245)].operations=[];turn(s);s.fighters[1].effects={};}for(const ratio of[2,2,1]){for(const s of[a,base]){s.rng=0x9e3779b9;turn(s,38245);}assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(a)-sum(base)*ratio)<=1);}for(const late of[false,true]){const s=make({...row(986),aStats:{spe:late?1:500}});let c;observe((e,x)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&x.a.side===0)c=x;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(c.modifier,late?1:1.5);}});

success.assertion: test('4865全部18招保留真实有序参数与64种子基础行为，18招完整2050原生用招，2403四原始参数保留且冗余末参数不改变初次时长',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const a=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(a.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));if(m.id===29252)assert.deepEqual(c.operations.find(o=>o.effectId===2403).params,[100,28,2,2]);turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('# 4865 base verified '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});
